speaker: thomas_pope
text: I carve. Sit down. Christmas is not a rehearsal, and this pie will not wait on a speech.

speaker: george_bryan
text: The bands were clean. The parish stared, which is what a parish does with players. Their chapel is two hundred yards off. It is theirs. We are not in it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Let them stare. We went in a body, and we are at this table, and the table is the stock's.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Then the stock shall have a health before Thomas cuts the drum. The grocer.

speaker: will_kemp
text: The health of the grocer, who will be first on the Queen's next paper and wait for his money till his beard is grey.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Drink it, and then give me the goose. I am not carving a health. I am carving meat.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Ale until six. Not after. I am saying it now, while the cup is still a pleasure and not an argument.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Six, then. The pie is as broad as a drum-head, and I will not argue with a pie.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Nick. A carol wants three parts. Thou art the lowest, and the fewest. Three notes. No more.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Stop. Under the note. That is thy Christmas music, and it is enough.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It held. Leave it held. Tomorrow is a hall, and a hall is a bad place to spend a voice proving it can.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: Does a court laugh differently from a yard?

speaker: thomas_pope
text: A court laughs later. A yard laughs when the line is funny. That is one answer.

speaker: will_kemp
text: A court laughs when it wishes to be seen laughing. That is two, and it is the truer.

speaker: george_bryan
text: A court laughs once, if it laughs, and the once is the whole of the review. That is three.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: A court does not laugh a boy off his note. That is four. I mean it as care, not as comfort.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Four answers, Sam, and they cannot all be true. The only one worth having will be heard tomorrow at about ten.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: About ten. I can wait for ten. How does a fairy run?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Not with a speech. Up. The feet. Like this.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: The feet, not the arms. I have it in my legs.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then keep it in thy legs. Do not spend it in the hall. A fairy is not on tomorrow's plot.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Sit, both of you. The mustard is not going to wait on a boy's question.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Six, by the inn's clock, near enough. The ale stops. I am obeyed. I note the wonder, and I do not make a speech of it.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Obeyed. My beard is not grey yet, and the grocer is not at this table to write it down.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: God keep you. I am going up to the cloaks and the fire. The pie has had me, and it was wide enough.
